one_liner_zh: Zoom 上季 EPS 2.22 美元暴超預期162%、營收 12.5 億美元，獲利能力極強但成長趨穩。
one_liner_en: Zoom crushed EPS at $2.22 by 162% on $1.25B revenue, with very strong profitability but plateauing growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 暴超預期 162.21%，獲利顯著優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號喜憂參半：EPS 暴超預期幅度極大，須留意是否含稅務利益或一次性項目，而非純經常性獲利。短期財報利多有助情緒。中期核心問題仍是成長：核心視訊已趨飽和，須看 AI、Phone、Contact Center 等新業務能否帶動營收重啟。低本益比與強勁現金流提供估值支撐與回購彈性。追蹤企業客戶數、淨流失率與經常性 EPS。
ai_view_en: Mixed signal: the enormous EPS beat warrants caution over whether it includes tax benefits or one-offs rather than pure recurring profit. Near term the beat aids sentiment. Mid term, the core issue is growth: core video is saturating, so the question is whether AI, Phone and Contact Center can re-ignite revenue. A low P/E and strong cash flow provide valuation support and buyback flexibility. Track enterprise customers, churn and normalized EPS.
highlights_zh: EPS 2.22 美元，超預期 162.21%，獲利能力極強
營收 12.5 億美元，企業端基本盤穩定
AI 功能與平台化（Workplace）推進
本益比約14倍，現金部位充裕
highlights_en: EPS of $2.22 beat by 162.21%, very strong profitability
Revenue of $1.25B with a stable enterprise base
AI features and platform strategy (Workplace) advancing
risks_zh: 本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限
巨額 EPS 超預期恐含稅務或一次性項目
視訊會議市場成熟與競爭壓力
risks_en: Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility
Massive EPS beat may include tax or one-off items
Mature video market and competitive pressure
